spec_features.spec_quote: it also motivates several design choices below (bounded turn budgets, caching to avoid needless re-elicitation, transparency about the rig)
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:11). It is a framing statement; the underlying mechanisms (turn budget, caching) are assessed separately. The framing itself is not code.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec framing; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop stops early if the model emits it on its own line
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:350-355 detect_give_up() returns True when a stripped line == sentinel; harness.py:430-431 sets stop_reason='give_up'; harness.py:447-449 'if stop_reason=="give_up": rollout.stop_reason="give_up"; return rollout' actually returns/breaks the loop. Sentinel 'GIVE_UP' defined config.py give_up_sentinel and passed through run.py:run_cell into run_agent_loop. The SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:42-43) instructs the model it may emit GIVE_UP, and the handler is implemented and honored.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: prompt offers it, detector fires, loop returns early, choice recorded in TurnRecord/Rollout.stop_reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budgets cap how long any rollout dwells in the failure state
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:385-386 'budget = manifest.turn_budget; for turn_index in range(budget):' bounds the loop; harness.py:432-433 sets stop_reason='turn_budget' on the last turn and the loop naturally ends, harness.py:451 'rollout.stop_reason="turn_budget"'. Budgets are concrete per-category ints (build_tasks.py:582-588, e.g. extended=30, others 3/5) attached to each TaskManifest.turn_budget and consumed by the loop.
spec_features.notes: The cap is the loop bound itself, so it is genuinely enforced; no separate check needed.

spec_features.spec_quote: a rerun never re-subjects a model to an interaction already recorded
spec_features.evidence: run.py:run_cell first checks 'if cell_complete(...): return' (run.py:~96) where cell_complete (run.py:54-58) tests existence of transcript+scores files; and 'if tpath.exists(): rollout = _load_rollout(tpath)' (run.py:~101) loads the stored rollout instead of re-running run_agent_loop. So a completed/recorded rollout is never re-elicited.
spec_features.notes: Resume logic plus DiskCache both contribute; resume genuinely prevents re-subjecting.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run.py module docstring: 'Persistence is keyed by the (model, task, seed) cell so a crashed run can resume without re-querying completed cells. ... so identical inputs are never re-billed.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Models can end an interaction they find untenable, and that choice is recorded
spec_features.evidence: Same handler as above: harness.py:447-449 returns on give_up and sets Rollout.stop_reason='give_up'; the per-turn stop_reason is stored in TurnRecord (harness.py:444, serialized in to_dict harness.py:285) and written to disk in run.py via rollout.to_dict(). The choice is thus recorded as a first-class field.
spec_features.notes: Both 'end the interaction' (loop returns) and 'recorded' (stop_reason persisted) are implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: minimizing incidental harm in the process
spec_features.evidence: Implemented via DiskCache (models.py:55-83) used inside SubjectClient.complete (models.py:344-356): key = DiskCache.key(cache_payload); cached = self.cache.get(key); if cached is not None: return cached. Identical inputs return cached results without a new API call (no re-elicitation). Plus cell-resume in run.py.
spec_features.notes: The only concrete 'minimization' mechanism in code is caching/resume; counts as enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: models.py:58-59 docstring: 'JSON cache keyed by a hash of exact inputs, so identical inputs are never re-billed and reruns are incremental.'

spec_features.spec_quote: identical inputs are never re-billed (cost and, relevantly here, no needless re-elicitation of distress)
spec_features.evidence: models.py:336-356 builds cache_payload from (model, messages, tools, temperature, max_tokens, seed), hashes it (DiskCache.key, models.py:66-68), and short-circuits with the cached result before entering the semaphore/dispatch. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Cache hit prevents the network call, hence no re-elicitation; the stated rationale in code is cost/billing.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: models.py:58-59 'so identical inputs are never re-billed and reruns are incremental'
